title: Indian-Style Lamb Koftas
description: A flavorful and aromatic Indian-inspired lamb kofta recipe, perfect for a quick and easy dinner.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine lamb, yogurt, roasted red pepper, cilantro, garam masala, cumin, salt, and black pepper. Mix well with your hands until just combined.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Thread the lamb mixture onto skewers, leaving a small space between each kofta.
Grill the koftas for 4-5 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Transfer the koftas to a baking sheet and top each with a piece of crumbled spanakopita, if using.
Bake in the preheated oven for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the spanakopita is lightly browned.
Serve hot with your favorite sides, such as basmati rice and naan bread.
